reading.title: What Is a Fable?
reading.purpose: Learn what makes a fable and what it teaches.
paras: A fable is a short story that teaches a lesson. The lesson is called the moral. Many fables are old folktales that people have told for years.
A fox may play a trick. A wise animal thinks first, but a foolish one does not. Some heroes go on a journey to find treasure.
